answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, revoked by a single upheld challenge, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. What survives to the grove is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the yarrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the knoll re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
